clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Jahan Hawkwing keeps Horde travelers supplied with armor. The tauren armorer works from this outpost in the Barrens, where predators roam the plains.

Jahan Hawkwing tends to the armor needs of Horde travelers and defenders at the Crossroads. In the Barrens, durable gear can mean survival against centaur, quilboar, and wild beasts. Jahan works with local leatherworkers, sending cured hides for delivery so his shop stays stocked with dependable tanned leather and sturdy chainmail.
